name: Archaeology, Technology, and Historical Structures
notes: Six courses (24 credits). The major is a separate pair of entries (major-aths-a-ba for the course-focused Track A and major-aths-b-ba for the research-focused Track B).
One of the two electives may be an independent study course.

COURSE LISTS ARE STALE - NEEDS VERIFICATION: the department's course-categories page still carries notes like 'taught by visiting faculty in fall 2014' and 'Formerly CLA 220', and roughly a third of the numbers it lists are absent from the 2025-26 catalog. Check the term schedule and your advisor before planning around any of them.
ME 104Q on the department page is the catalog's ME 104 (The Engineering of Bridges); both codes are accepted.
The minor page states no upper-level writing policy - the ULW list on the major page is described as the way Track A majors satisfy the College requirement.

requirementGroups.label: Foundation course: engineering
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two foundation courses: One from engineering and one from archaeology or architecture. [Foundation Courses] ME 104Q: The Engineering of Bridges or ME 106: Engineering in Antiquity

requirementGroups.label: Foundation course: archaeology or architecture
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One from engineering and one from archaeology or architecture. [Foundation Courses] AHST 107: Ancient Architecture or AHST 188: Cities and Architecture in Pre-Columbian Mesoamerica and the Andes or AHST 243: Architecture of the Classical World; CLST 230: Classical Archaeology: Greek Art and Archaeology or CLST 231: Classical Archaeology: Roman Art and Archaeology

requirementGroups.label: Two core courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two core courses: These can be selected from different cores.
requirementGroups.note: Unlike the major, the minor's two core courses need NOT come from the same core.

requirementGroups.label: Two elective courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two elective courses: These can either be electives or the core courses; one elective can be an independent study course
